newsitem.title: UK: List of recent highs and lows for major currencies.
newsitem.headline: List of recent highs and lows for major currencies.

text.p: Following is a list of recent highs and lows of major currency pairs.
* DOLLAR/MARK -- 1.7423 on June 6, highest since week of Feb 18, 1994 (1.7530).
next level on upside -- 1.7686 (week of Feb 11, 1994).
* DOLLAR/YEN -- 111.80 on June 9, lowest since Dec 6, 1996 (111.73).
next level on downside -- 111.33 (Nov 25 1996), then 111.05 (Nov 22 1996).
* MARK/YEN -- 65.22 on June 9, lowest since Aug 31, 1995 (66.07).
next level on downside -- 64.92, lowest since Aug 24, 1995, then 64.85 (Aug 23, 1995)
* MARK/FRENCH FRANC -- 3.3860 on June 2, day after left-wing victory in french election, highest since Dec 11, 1996 (3.3867).
next level on upside -- 3.3935 (Dec 3, 1996)
* DOLLAR/FRENCH FRANC -- 5.8801 on June 6, highest since week of April 22, 1994 (5.8912).
next level -- 5.8925 (week of Apr 15, 1994) then 5.9055 (week of Feb 25, 1994).
* DOLLAR/SWISS FRANC -- 1.4625 on June 6, highest since May 7 1997 (1.4644).
next level on upside: 1.4775 (May 6)
* MARK/SWISS FRANC -- recent low -- 82.35 on May 21, lowest since Oct 24, 1996 (82.30).
next level on downside - 82.13 (Oct 23, 1996) then 82.11 (Oct 18).
recent high -- 84.10 on June 6, highest since May 16 (84.30).
next level on upside - 84.70 (May 15).
* STERLING/MARK -- 2.8331 on June 4, highest since week of Aug 7, 1992 (2.8473).
next level -- 2.8543 (week of July 31, 1992).
* STERLING/YEN -- 183.32 on June 9, lowest since week of Dec 6, 1996
